title: Designating and Changing the Named Companion on a Crestline Companion Pass
content:
Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, a pass holder designates one named companion where the product requires designation, and may change the designated companion at most the product's allowed number of times over the life of the pass, as recorded in the designation changes used on the pass; the first designation is not a change.

## Conditions for a change

A designation change is made only while the pass is active, as shown on the pass record, and only when no unflown companion trip is booked for the current companion.

| Pass status | Unflown trip booked for the current companion | Change may be made |
|---|---|---|
| active | none | yes, within the allowance |
| active | one or more | no |
| issued, used, expired or revoked | — | no |

## Fee and effect

A change carries the product's designation change fee, charged as its own charge entry, and the new companion may travel from the moment of the change.

## Certificates

Certificates have no designated companion and may be used for any companion the holder names at booking.

**Hypothetical example.** A pass allowing 1 change shows 0 changes used. The holder designates a first companion (not a change; the count stays at 0), later changes to a second companion while the pass is active and nothing is booked for the first (the count becomes 1), and has no change left after that.
